name: feature-pack-notifications
title: Notifications Feature Pack
description: An application notification inbox with read, open, and deletion actions.
docs:
`feature-pack-notifications` installed a provider-neutral view and `.constructive/feature-packs/notifications.json`. Import from `@/blocks/feature-packs/notifications/notifications-feature-pack`. The host must supply the view resource, policy, and actions; add `console-module-notifications` when Console Kit should own discovery and Constructive integration.

Degraded states: The host must provide an authoritative inbox, policy, and callbacks; absent operations stay unavailable and mutations require a refreshed resource.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/features/notifications/
